title: Learn Spanish from A1 to C1, grammar explained · Glossa
description: Free Spanish course for English speakers: Castilian Spanish from first words to C1 in 78 modules, grammar explained, feedback that says why an answer is wrong.

card.title: Spanish
card.text: Castilian Spanish from first words to C1, with DELE practice papers and 13 professional specializations.

heading: Learn Spanish with the grammar explained.
lead: A complete course in Castilian Spanish for English speakers, from pronunciation and first words to the subjunctive, registers and literature at C1. Each module explains its grammar directly, then practises it with exercises whose feedback says what was wrong and why.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. DELE practice papers, specializations, stories, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

items.title: Tier 1 · A1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: Pronunciation, spelling, greetings, articles, ser, numbers.

items.title: Tier 2 · A1 · Everyday basics
items.text: The present tense, adjectives, estar and hay, questions.

items.title: Tier 3 · A1–A2 · Daily life
items.text: Stem-changing and reflexive verbs, gustar, plans and shopping.

items.title: Tier 4 · A2 · The past
items.text: The past tenses and object pronouns.

items.title: Tier 5 · B1 · Building fluency
items.text: Por and para, future, conditional, imperative, present subjunctive.

items.title: Tier 6 · B1–B2 · Intermediate
items.text: Relative clauses, compound tenses, reported speech, se.

items.title: Tier 7 · B2 · Upper intermediate
items.text: The imperfect subjunctive, conditional sentences, connectors.

items.title: Tier 8 · C1 · Advanced
items.text: Fine points of grammar, style, colloquial Spanish, varieties.

sections.heading: A course that explains, then checks

items.title: Grammar taught directly
items.text: Ser and estar, the preterite and the imperfect, por and para and the subjunctive each get their own modules, explained in plain English before you practise them.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: Every answer gets feedback with the reason and a link to the grammar rule, and the exercises you got wrong come back at the end.

items.title: Every Spanish word can be tapped
items.text: Tap any word in a lesson, exercise or text for its meaning, its forms and audio, and add it to your vocabulary.

items.title: The Spanish of Spain, and its varieties
items.text: Castilian Spanish with audio from a voice from Spain, notes on Latin American usage, and a module on the varieties of Spanish in the last tier.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Pronunciation activities in the modules assess how you read Spanish sentences aloud, with written feedback, and let you compare your recording with the reference audio.

items.title: Common traps
items.text: Short units on the mistakes English speakers make in Spanish, from false friends to tener and hacer where English uses "to be".

sections.heading: Practice papers for the DELE
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for each of the six DELE levels, A1 to C2, in the exam's task formats with original content. They are part of Premium.
items: DELE practice papers: what each level asks, what the papers cover and where they differ from the real exam.

sections.heading: Spanish for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses, each with nine modules in three stages (foundations, working vocabulary and professional), which open as you reach tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the course. They are part of Premium.

items.question: Is the Spanish course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 78 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free, with no limit on lessons. Premium adds the extras listed above.

items.question: Which Spanish does Glossa teach?
items.answer: Castilian Spanish, the Spanish of Spain, with notes where Latin American usage differs and a module on the varieties of Spanish.

items.question: I already know some Spanish. Do I have to start from the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test finds the tier to start from, and you can open any module.

items.question: How far does the course go?
items.answer: To C1: the last tier covers the fine points of the subjunctive, prepositions and verb government, registers and style, colloquial Spanish, history, literature and law.

items.question: Can it prepare me for the DELE?
items.answer: The course covers the grammar and vocabulary from A1 to C1, and Premium adds timed practice papers for every DELE level. The papers have no speaking test and their results are an estimate, so they are practice, not a prediction of your result.

items.question: I speak another language. Is there a version for me?
items.answer: Spanish is also taught with explanations in Russian, Ukrainian, Finnish, German, Portuguese and Italian, with the same DELE papers: Spanish for Russian, Ukrainian, Finnish, German, Portuguese and Italian speakers.

closing.heading: Start with the first module, or find your level.
closing.text: Sign in with Google, take the placement test if you already know some Spanish, and open the module it suggests.
